messages:
maria-cs: Quick weekly NeoEdge health snapshot — focusing on p95/p99 by route + model and streaming vs non-streaming. TL;DR: streaming tails are elevated on /chat/message and /rerank, small error uptick, spend +4% M/M. Posting raw table and a short ask.

maria-cs: ```
Route             | Model         | Streaming | p95(ms) | p99(ms) | Errors% | WeeklySpend($)
/chat/message     | gpt-j-7b-ql   | Yes       | 380     | 1120    | 0.6     | 4200
/chat/message     | gpt-j-7b-ql   | No        | 240     | 890     | 0.2     | 3900
/embeddings/text  | embed-v2      | No        | 85      | 210     | 0.05    | 1100
/rerank           | re-rank-1     | Yes       | 420     | 1500    | 1.8     | 600
```

maria-cs: Ask: kevin/tom can you confirm whether these streaming tails align with any infra changes (autoscaler, kernel or nvidia driver tweaks)? lisa/sophie: is this visible in customer tickets or renewal discussions?

kevin-sre: saw correlated spikes at 03:14-03:22 UTC on Thursday — autoscaler opened 3 new pods, cold KV cache + streaming overhead. labels: `autoscale=burst`, `node-type=g5`

kevin-sre: quick note: non-streaming path uses batched decoding in runtime; streaming uses per-token flush and hits serialization cost when many small concurrent streams.

tom-eng: thanks — open PR to tweak streaming batch_window from 8ms -> 12ms for gpt-j-7b-ql on chat-route. should reduce syscalls/serialization. I'll stage to canary tonight.

lisa-cs: flagged as medium renewal risk for NeoEdge — they pinged CS yesterday about chat lag on mobile. UX sessions show p99 hits are visible to end-users when >1s. I'm prepping a short note to share with them once we have a mitig.

sophie-acct: I'll schedule a 30m sync with NeoEdge for early next week. want to share the mitigation plan + temporary config to route heavy traffic to non-streaming path if needed.

maria-cs: action items:
- tom-eng: roll canary for batch_window change and confirm p99 drop (target: -200–300ms on streaming p99) — due: tonight CET.
- kevin-sre: watch autoscaler policy and temp bump min-replicas to smooth warmups if canary doesn't hit target — due: EOD tomorrow.
- lisa-cs/sophie-acct: customer comms + contingency routing plan (route to non-streaming model variant) — sync scheduled.

observability-bot: New perf dashboard snapshot: https://obs.redwood/neoedge/1793012345 (contains heatmap, per-route traces, and error clusters).

kevin-sre: one more datapoint — rerank streaming p99 dominated by one node with OOM kill events early Wed. I restarted ring buffer and memory cap applied; will monitor.

maria-cs: thanks all — will post follow-up after canary runs. :thumbsup:
